title: Ukraine launches its largest drone attack on Russia and hits the Crimean bridge
caption:
Russia's defence ministry said its air defences shot down 1,336 Ukrainian drones overnight, the largest attack since the war began, and drones also hit the bridge linking Russia to annexed Crimea. Moscow's mayor said about 600 drones flew toward the capital, and road traffic on the bridge was restricted. The attack comes days before Trump, Xi and Putin are expected to meet in China.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
